question: The present cost of a hospital is ₹1,82,590. After a year, its cost increased to ₹1,95,382. The percentage increase (rounded off to the nearest integer) in the cost of the hospital is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cost increase = 1,95,382 − 1,82,590 = 12,792

Percentage increase = (12,792 ÷ 1,82,590) × 100

Approximate 1% of 1,82,590 ≈ 1,826. Since 1,826 × 7 = 12,782, the value is ≈ 7%.

**∴ The correct answer is 7%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Original Cost = ₹1,82,590

New Cost = ₹1,95,382

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Increase = [(New Value − Original Value) ÷ Original Value] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4790c0fdd9d710d2af7ff4497c4bd2552a7e625c2636b37e834b8f724877c879.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Increase = 1,95,382 − 1,82,590 = 12,792

⇒ Percentage Increase = (12,792 ÷ 1,82,590) × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase ≈ 0.070058 × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase ≈ 7.0058%

⇒ Rounded to nearest integer = 7%

**∴ The correct answer is 7%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change

It represents the relationship between an old value and a new value. Formula: [(Difference) ÷ (Original Value)] × 100.

Rounding Off Rules

If the decimal part is 0.5 or more, round up to the next integer; otherwise, keep the current integer.

Base Value in Percentage

Always use the initial or original value as the denominator (base) when calculating the percentage of increase or decrease.
